name: Windows Installer

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          update: true
          install: >-
            git
            mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pip
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-setuptools
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-wheel
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-psutil
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyserial
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqt5
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqtwebengine
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqtgraph
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-numpy
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-scipy
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-matplotlib
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pandas
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqt5-sip
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqt5-stubs
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqt5-webengine
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3-pyqt5-webengine-stubs
            mingw-w64-x86_64-innosetup

      - name: Provision MSYS2 Environment
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          # Install Python dependencies
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          
          # Build the C core
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake ..
          make

      - name: Create Installer
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          # Create the directory structure for the installer
          mkdir -p installer/OpenPLC
          
          # Copy necessary files
          cp -r core installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r ui installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r scripts installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r docs installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r examples installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r tests installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .github installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .vscode installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitignore installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r LICENSE installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r README.md installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r requirements.txt installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r setup.py installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r MANIFEST.in installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitattributes installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitmodules installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .editorconfig installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .pre-commit-config.yaml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .flake8 installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .pylintrc installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .mypy.ini installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .isort.cfg installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .bandit installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .safety-policy.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .readthedocs.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .travis.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .appveyor.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .circleci installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .github installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .vscode installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitignore installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r LICENSE installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r README.md installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r requirements.txt installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r setup.py installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r MANIFEST.in installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitattributes installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .gitmodules installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .editorconfig installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .pre-commit-config.yaml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .flake8 installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .pylintrc installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .mypy.ini installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .isort.cfg installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .bandit installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .safety-policy.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .readthedocs.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .travis.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .appveyor.yml installer/OpenPLC/
          cp -r .circleci installer/OpenPLC/
          
          # Copy MSYS2 environment
          cp -r /mingw64 installer/OpenPLC/msys2
          cp -r /usr installer/OpenPLC/msys2
          
          # Create launcher script
          cat > installer/OpenPLC/StartOpenPLC.bat << 'EOF'
          @echo off
          setlocal
          set "MSYS2_PATH=%~dp0msys2"
          set "PATH=%MSYS2_PATH%\mingw64\bin;%MSYS2_PATH%\usr\bin;%PATH%"
          start "" "%MSYS2_PATH%\mingw64\bin\bash.exe" -c "cd /c/OpenPLC && ./start_openplc.sh"
          endlocal
          EOF

      - name: Build Inno Setup Installer
        run: |
          iscc.exe setup.iss

      - name: Upload Installer Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenPLC-Windows-Installer
          path: OpenPLC-Setup.exe

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: OpenPLC-Setup.exe
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
